source: PHC business-rule specifications v1.1 final synchronized

cases.oracle: employee only; prescription must exist and belong to claimant
configured expense-date window is enforced, including boundary
ownership-scoped record access and role-based function access
stock change is audited; below-threshold change queues staff warning; negative stock is rejected
covered record and inventory actions append audit evidence
patient-identifiable fields are not included in patient-derived report output
demographics report groups patient and visit counts by student/employee category without exposing identifiers

limitations: Tests assert the current stated module contract; no unstated privacy, delivery, or retention rule is added.
